2026_02_CAR_ATL.headline: Quarterback uncertainty hangs over an early NFC South reset
2026_02_CAR_ATL.paragraph1: Carolina and Atlanta both arrive at their first division game looking for a reset after opening losses. The Panthers’ Week 2 scouting report notes that Carolina has won the last three meetings, while Atlanta’s current depth-chart story says Kevin Stefanski had not yet named his starting quarterback. That uncertainty changes the preparation problem for Carolina, but Atlanta still has to solve the mistakes that hurt it in Pittsburgh. The Panthers’ best path is to make whichever Falcons quarterback starts play from uncomfortable down-and-distance.
2026_02_CAR_ATL.model_rationale: Carolina’s ability to create predictable passing situations matters most while Atlanta sorts through its quarterback decision and tries to stabilize an offense coming off an uneven opener.
